```python
n = int(input('Kis number ki table? '))
```

Jarvis, coding me loop kya hota hai

Loop matlab ek hi kaam ko baar-baar karna, bina baar-baar likhe.

Example: agar tumhe 1 se 100 tak ginati likhni ho, to 100 line likhne ki jagah loop 3 line me wahi kaam kar dega:

```python

```

Jaise pankha ghoomta rehta hai jab tak band na karo — loop bhi shart tak chalta rehta hai.
Mujhe batao python me even odd kaise check kare

Number ko 2 se bhag karke dekho:

```python
n = int(input('Number dalo: '))
if n % 2 == 0:
    print(n, 'even hai')
else:
    print(n, 'odd hai')
```

% ka matlab hai remainder — 2 se bhag par remainder 0 aaya to even, warna odd.

```python

```

Prime number wo hota hai jo sirf 1 aur khud se kata jata hai:

```python
n = int(input('Number dalo: '))
prime = True
for i in range(2, n):
    if n % i == 0:
        prime = False
        break
print('Prime hai' if prime else 'Prime nahi hai')
```

2 se lekar n-1 tak kisi se bhi kat gaya to prime nahi hai.

87 * 6 jaldi kaise nikale?

87 * 6 jaldi nikalne ki trick: 87 ko 90 - 3 samjho.

90 * 6 = 540, aur 3 * 6 = 18.

540 - 18 = 522. To 87 * 6 = 522.

Class se ek chhoti ghadi (clock) banao jo samay badhaye aur dikhaye

```python
class Ghadi:
    def __init__(self, ghanta, minute):
        self.ghanta = ghanta
        self.minute = minute

    def ek_minute(self):
        self.minute += 1
        if self.minute == 60:
            self.minute = 0
            self.ghanta = (self.ghanta + 1) % 24

    def dikhao(self):
        return f'{self.ghanta:02d}:{self.minute:02d}'

g = Ghadi(23, 59)

```

Form submit karte hi page refresh ho jata hai aur data gayab — kyun

Form ka asal kaam data server ko bhejna hai — submit par browser page dobara load karta hai, isliye sab gayab lagta hai.

Sirf JavaScript se kaam karna hai to function se false return karo:

```html
<form onsubmit="return meraKaam()">
```

```javascript
function meraKaam() {
  // yahan apna kaam karo
  return false;  // refresh ruk jayega
}
```
Code badla par browser me purana page hi dikh raha hai — kya kare

Ye browser ke cache ki shararat hai — wo purani file yaad rakhkar wahi dikhata hai.

Ilaaj: Ctrl + Shift + R dabakar hard refresh karo. Phir bhi na badle to jaancho ki tum wahi file save karke wahi khol rahe ho — aksar galat file edit ho rahi hoti hai.
Mobile par page bahut chhota aur zooom karke padhna pad raha hai — kya bhool gaya

Tum meta viewport wali line bhool gaye ho. Bina iske mobile browser page ko computer jitna chauda maan kar chhota kar deta hai.

```html
<head>
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
</head>
```

Ye ek line har page ke head me honi hi chahiye.
JavaScript me bracket { } band karna bhool gaya to kya hota hai

Ek bhi bracket kam ho to poori script ruk jati hai — sirf wo function nahi, baaki sab JS bhi band.

Console me 'SyntaxError' aur line number dikhta hai. VS Code me bracket par click karne se uska jodidaar chamak jata hai — wahi se gin kar jaancho ki har { ka } hai.
CSS likha hai par kisi element par asar nahi ho raha — ek aur wajah batao (order wali)

Agar ek hi cheez par do niyam takra rahe hain to baad me likha hua (aur zyada takatwar — id > class > element) jeet-ta hai.

```css
p { color: blue; }
p { color: red; }  /* ye wala lagega, kyunki baad me hai */
```

404 ka matlab hai href wala page us jagah hai hi nahi. Jaancho: - File ka naam aur href akshar-se-akshar milte hain? (About.html vs about.html) - File usi folder me hai? Dusre folder me hai to path me folder ka naam chahiye - .html lagana to nahi bhool gaye? ```html About ```
img tag me src ki jagah scr likh diya to kya hoga

Photo nahi dikhegi — browser scr ko pehchanta hi nahi, use lagega photo ka path diya hi nahi gaya. ```html ``` Attribute ke naam pehle se tay hain — src, href, width — inki spelling ek akshar bhi idhar-udhar nahi ho sakti.
JavaScript me = aur === me galti karne se kya hota hai

Ek = value dene ke liye hai, === jaanch ke liye.

```javascript
let x = 5;          // value di
if (x === 5) { }    // jaanch ki — sahi
if (x = 5) { }      // galti! ye jaanch nahi, value de raha hai
```

if ke andar galti se = laga doge to shart hamesha ajeeb behave karegi. Niyam: jaanch me hamesha ===.

VS Code Microsoft ka muft code-editor hai. Ye:

- Tags ko rang-biranga dikhata hai, galti turant dikhti hai
- Tag shuru karte hi band tag khud bana deta hai
- File ke hisab se salah (suggestion) deta hai

Banayi hui HTML file ko browser me kaise khole

Dhyaan rahe, address me file:/// se shuru hoga — ye tumhare computer ki file hai, internet par nahi gayi. Badlav dekhne ke liye file save karke browser me refresh (F5) karo.

Notepad me code likho, phir Save As me naam ke aakhir me .html lagao aur 'Save as type' me 'All Files' chuno.

```
mera-page.html
```

Bootstrap kya hai, simple shabdon me batao

Bootstrap tayyar (ready-made) CSS ka bada dabba hai — button, menu, card, grid sab bane-banaye milte hain, bas class lagani hoti hai.

```html
<button class="btn btn-primary">Button</button>
```

Isse site jaldi aur saaf banti hai. Par pehle aam CSS seekh lo, warna Bootstrap jadui lagega aur galti pakadna mushkil hoga.
jQuery kya hai aur aaj kal iska kya haal hai
Library aur framework me kya farak hota hai

Library = tum uske hisse bula kar use karte ho, control tumhare paas hai (jaise jQuery).
Framework = wo tumhare code ko apne dhache me bulata hai, control uske niyamo ke paas hai (jaise React, Angular).

Misaal: library ek auzaar (tool) hai jo tum uthate ho; framework ek tayyar workshop hai jisme tumhe uske niyam se kaam karna padta hai.
Responsive website ka matlab kya hota hai, detail me batao

Responsive matlab site har screen par sahi dikhe — bade monitor par chaudi, mobile par ek column me simat kar.

Iske liye teen cheezein lagti hain:

1. Meta viewport wali line
2. Percent/fr wali lachili (flexible) chaudai, fix pixel kam
3. Media query — chhoti screen ke liye alag niyam

Aaj kal zyada log phone par site dekhte hain, isliye responsive hona aaj ki pehli shart hai.
SEO ke liye page ke title ki kya ahmiyat hai

Title wo naam hai jo Google search me badi neeli line me dikhta hai. Achha title:

- Page kis baare me hai, saaf bataye
- Bahut lamba na ho (lagbhag 50-60 akshar)
- Har page ka alag ho

```html
<title>Sharma Kirana Store — Taaza Sabzi aur Ghar ka Saaman</title>
```

Bina title ke page search me 'Untitled' jaisa dikhta hai aur log click nahi karte.
Meta description kya hoti hai aur kyun likhte hain

Ye page ki 2-line wali jaankari hai jo Google search me title ke neeche dikhti hai.

```html
<meta name="description" content="Sharma Store par taazi sabzi, phal aur roz ka saaman sahi daam par. Home delivery uplabdh.">
```

Ye page par nahi dikhti, sirf search me dikhti hai — achhi likhi ho to zyada log click karte hain.
HTTPS aur HTTP me kya farak hai, site ke liye kaunsa sahi hai

HTTPS me S ka matlab hai Secure — tumhare aur website ke beech ki baat band (encrypted) hokar jati hai, beech wala padh nahi sakta.

HTTP par password jaisi cheez khule me ja sakti hai. Aaj kal browser HTTP wali site par 'Not secure' ki chetaavni dikhata hai, isliye hamesha HTTPS wali hosting chuno — GitHub Pages jaisi free hosting par ye khud milta hai.
URL (website ke address) ke hisse kaun kaun se hote hain

Ek URL ko aise todo:

```
https://www.meridukaan.in/shop/shoes.html
```

- **https://** — tareeka (protocol), surakshit wala
- **www.meridukaan.in** — domain, site ka naam
- **/shop/** — folder
- **shoes.html** — wo wala page

Address galat likhne par 404 aata hai — isiliye hisse samajhna kaam ka hai.
Hosting aur domain me kya farak hai

Domain = tumhari site ka naam/address (jaise meridukaan.in). Hosting = wo jagah (server) jahan tumhari files rehti hain.

Misaal: domain ghar ka pata hai, hosting wo plot/ghar hai jahan saaman rakha hai. Dono chahiye — pata bina ghar nahi milega, ghar bina pata bekaar.

Shuruaat me free hosting + unka diya hua lamba address chal jata hai, domain baad me kharid sakte ho.

Alt text ke teen fayde: 1. Photo load na ho to wahi text dikhta hai — user ko pata chalta hai wahan kya tha 2. Jo log dekh nahi sakte, unka software alt padhkar sunata hai 3. Google photo ko alt se samajhta hai — search me photo upar aane me madad milti hai ```html ``` 'Photo' ya 'image' jaisa aam alt bekaar hai — photo me kya hai, wahi likho.
Website ki photo halki (compress) kyun rakhni chahiye

Badi photo = dheemi website. Phone ki 5 MB wali photo page ko khulne me kai second laga degi aur log page band karke chale jayenge.

Niyam:

- Photo ko page par dikhne wale size se bada mat rakho
- Upload se pehle online tool se halka (compress) kar lo — quality me zyada farak nahi padta
- Logo ke liye PNG, aam photo ke liye JPG sahi rehta hai
Charset UTF-8 wali meta line kya karti hai

```html
<meta charset="UTF-8">
```

Ye line browser ko batati hai ki file ke akshar kis bhasha-vyavastha (encoding) me hain. Iske bina Hindi (Devanagari) ya khaas chinh ajeeb dabbo (□□□) me dikh sakte hain.

Aaj bazaar jaana hai, list bana li hai par mann sust hai.
Bazaar ka kaam chhota lagta hai par list ho to jaldi nipta jata hai. Pehle zaroori cheezein lo, phir idhar udhar dekho. Thakaan ho to beech me ek jagah baithkar paani pi lena.
Meri cycle ki hawa kam lag rahi hai, shaam ko dost ke ghar jaana hai.
Pehle hawa bharwa lena, warna raste me pareshani hogi. Helmet aur paani ki bottle saath rakhna. Dost ke ghar jaana hai to time se nikalna, jaldi me chalana theek nahi.
Aaj ghar ki safai karni hai par shuru kahan se karun samajh nahi aa raha.
Sabse pehle ek kamra pakdo, poora ghar ek saath mat dekho. Pehle kachra, phir jhaadu, phir cheezein jagah par. Ek ghante me farq dikhega aur mann bhi halka hoga.
Kal subah train pakadni hai, taiyaari kya karun?
Aaj raat hi bag pack kar lo — kapde, charger, paani, khana aur ticket ka screenshot. Alarm do jagah lagao aur station ke liye extra 30 minute rakho. Taiyaari pehle ho to safar shaant hota hai.
Aaj doston ke saath park jaane ka plan hai.
Badhaai ho, park wala plan hamesha mood fresh karta hai. Halka khana, paani aur ek ball ya cards le jana. Phone kam chalana, warna park ghar jaisa hi lagne lagega.
Mera kamra bahut bikhra hua hai, dekhkar hi thak jata hoon.
Bikhra kamra mann ko bhi bikhra deta hai. Sirf 15 minute ka timer lagao aur bed ke aas paas ki jagah saaf karo. Poora perfect nahi chahiye, bas dikhne layak sudhaar kaafi hai shuruaat ke liye.
Aaj bijli baar baar ja rahi hai, garmi bhi hai.
Bijli ka khel aisa hi hai. Paani paas rakho, pankha wali jagah par baitho, aur phone ki battery bachakar rakho. Zaroori kaam ho to pehle nipta lo, baaki ke liye ye waqt kitab ya baat-cheet ka hai.
Main aaj padosi ki madad karke aaya hoon, achha lag raha hai.
Kisi ki madad ka sukh alag hi hota hai. Aise chhote kaam dil ko bada banate hain. Aaj ka din isi khushi ke saath yaad rakhna — tumne kisi ka din halka kiya.
Aaj maine pehli baar akele khana banaya, thoda namak zyada ho gaya.
Pehli koshish me namak zyada hona koi badi baat nahi. Agli baar namak do hisso me dalna aur beech me chakh lena. Khana banana ek kala hai, galtiyon se hi haath saaf hota hai.
Shaam ko chhat par tahelne ka mann hai.
Chhat ki shaam din bhar ki thakaan utaar deti hai. Halki hawa, doori par doobta sooraj aur thodi si khamoshi — ye sab dawai jaisa kaam karta hai. Bas railings se door surakshit jagah par tahelna.
Aaj mere paas khaali time bahut hai, bore ho raha hoon.
Khaali time ko dushman mat samjho. Ek purani hobby uthao — drawing, gaana, ya kisi dost ko call. Bore hona kabhi kabhi dimaag ka rest bhi hota hai, har ghanta bhara hona zaroori nahi.
Kal mera birthday hai, thoda excited hoon.
Birthday ki excitement hi din ko khaas banati hai. Aaj un logon ko yaad karo jo saal bhar saath rahe. Koi bada plan ho ya na ho, ek chhoti si khushi apne liye zaroor rakhna.
Aaj maine subah ki sair shuru ki hai.
Subah ki sair ki shuruaat hi jeet hai. Pehle din zyada mat chalo, bas routine banao. Kuch din me neend, bhookh aur mood — teeno me farq dikhega.
Mera paudha sookh raha tha, aaj usme nayi konpal aayi hai.
Nayi konpal umeed jaisi hoti hai — dheere aati hai par sach me aati hai. Paudhe ko roj thoda paani aur dhoop do. Tumhari dekhbhal rang laayi hai.
Aaj purani photo album dekhkar bahut yaadein taaza ho gayi.
Purani photos time machine jaisi hoti hain. Kuch pal hasa deti hain, kuch aankhein nam kar deti hain. Jin logon ki yaad aayi, unme se kisi ek ko aaj message kar do — use bhi achha lagega.
Mujhe bina baat ke rone ka mann karta hai aaj.

Rone ka mann karna kamzori nahi hai, kabhi kabhi dil bhara hota hai aur bahana nahi milta. Akele me ro lena bura nahi, uske baad munh dho lo, paani piyo aur kisi apne se thodi baat karo. Agar ye haal roj hone lage to kisi bade ya doctor se baat zaroor karna.
Main sabke saamne hasta hoon par andar se khaali lagta hai.
Bahar ki hansi aur andar ka khaalipan ek saath ho sakta hai. Kisi ek bharosemand insaan ko sach batao — sabko nahi, bas ek ko. Sach bolne se bojh aadha ho jata hai.
Mujhe lagta hai main kisi kaam ka nahi hoon.

Ye khayal sach nahi, ye thake hue dimaag ki awaaz hai. Apni ek chhoti si uplabdhi yaad karo — kisi ki madad, koi pura kaam. Aaj ka din sirf aaram aur ek chhote kaam ke naam karo, khud ko sazaa mat do.
Meri dost ne mujhe ignore kar diya, bahut bura lag raha hai.
Ignore hona sach me chubhta hai. Pehle ye socho ki ho sakta hai wo kisi pareshani me ho. Ek baar shaant message karke pooch lo. Jawab na aaye to apni izzat bachakar peeche hatna bhi sahi hota hai.
Mujhe apni hi safalta par shak hota hai, lagta hai sab luck tha.
Ye ehsaas bahut se mehnati logon ko hota hai. Luck mauka deta hai, par use pakadna mehnat hi hoti hai. Apne puraane sangharsh yaad karo — tum yahan tak yun hi nahi pahunche.
Ghar me sab mujhse naraaz lagte hain, mann ghabra raha hai.
Pehle sach jaanne ki koshish karo, andaze par mat jiyo. Jis se sabse zyada darr lag raha hai, usse shaant time par baat karo. Kai baar naraazgi humare dimaag me asal se badi ho jati hai.
Mujhe kal ki baat yaad karke aaj bhi sharm aa rahi hai.
Sharm wali yaadein sabke paas hoti hain, log unhe humse zyada jaldi bhool jate hain. Agar kisi ka dil dukha ho to ek saaf sorry kaafi hai. Khud ko baar baar wahi sazaa mat do.
Main naye logon se milne me bahut ghabrata hoon.
Naye logon se ghabrahat aam baat hai. Pehle ek chhoti si baat se shuru karo — mausam, jagah ya koi aam sawal. Sabse dostana banna zaroori nahi, bas khud ko mauqa do.
Mujhe lagta hai meri zindagi me kuch badal hi nahi raha.
Badlav kabhi kabhi itna dheere hota hai ki dikhta nahi. Ek mahine pehle ki apni haalat se tulna karo, dusron se nahi. Chhoti progress bhi progress hoti hai, bas use likhne ki aadat dalo.
Aaj pehli baar kisi ne meri dil se tareef ki, aankhein bhar aayi.
Dil se ki gayi tareef seedha dil ko chhooti hai. Is pal ko sambhal kar rakho. Tum is tareef ke haqdaar ho — use sharmakar kam mat karo, muskurakar swikar karo.
Mujhe apne bhai se jalan hoti hai kabhi kabhi, bura lagta hai.
Jalan insaani bhavna hai, par use rishte par haavi mat hone do. Uski safalta ko apni haar mat samjho. Apne raste par dhyaan do — har phool apne mausam me khilta hai.
Main kisi ko kho dene ke dar se pareshan rehta hoon.
Kho dene ka dar pyaar ki gehrai dikhata hai, par roj ka dar sukh cheen leta hai. Jo aaj saath hai, uske saath aaj jeeyo. Kal ki chinta me aaj ka rishta kamzor mat karo.
Mujhe sab kuch chodkar kahin door jaane ka mann karta hai.
Ye mann aksar bhaagne ka nahi, aaram ka hota hai. Pehle ek din ki chhutti, ek safar ya bas routine se break lo. Bade faisle thake hue mann se mat lo.
Aaj main khud se hi naraaz hoon.
Khud se naraazgi sabse bhaari hoti hai. Khud se waise baat karo jaise apne sabse achhe dost se karte. Galti sudharne ka ek kadam lo, khud ko kosna band karo.
Mujhe lagta hai log mujhe pasand nahi karte.
Ye lagna aur sach hona alag baatein hain. Thaka dimaag har ishare ko bura samajh leta hai. Un do-teen logon ko yaad karo jo sach me tumhari parwah karte hain — wahi tumhari asal duniya hai.

Uttar Pradesh ki rajdhani kya hai?
Uttar Pradesh ki rajdhani Lucknow hai. UP Bharat ka sabse zyada jansankhya wala rajya hai.
Madhya Pradesh ki rajdhani kaunsi hai?
Madhya Pradesh ki rajdhani Bhopal hai. Ise jheelon ka shahar bhi kehte hain.
Rajasthan ki rajdhani kya hai?
Rajasthan ki rajdhani Jaipur hai, jise Pink City (Gulabi Nagari) bhi kehte hain kyunki wahan ki purani imaratein gulabi rang ki hain.
Maharashtra ki rajdhani kya hai?
Maharashtra ki rajdhani Mumbai hai. Mumbai Bharat ki aarthik rajdhani mani jati hai aur wahan Bollywood film industry hai.
Gujarat ki rajdhani kaunsi hai?
Gujarat ki rajdhani Gandhinagar hai. Ahmedabad Gujarat ka sabse bada shahar hai.
Karnataka ki rajdhani kya hai?
Karnataka ki rajdhani Bengaluru hai. Ise Bharat ki IT rajdhani aur Garden City bhi kehte hain.
Tamil Nadu ki rajdhani kaunsi hai?
Tamil Nadu ki rajdhani Chennai hai, jo Bay of Bengal ke kinare basa ek bada bandargah shahar hai.
Kerala ki rajdhani kya hai?
Kerala ki rajdhani Thiruvananthapuram hai. Kerala ko 'God's Own Country' bhi kaha jata hai.
West Bengal ki rajdhani kaunsi hai?
West Bengal ki rajdhani Kolkata hai. Kolkata Hugli nadi ke kinare hai aur kabhi Bharat ki rajdhani bhi raha hai (1911 tak).
Bihar ki rajdhani kya hai?
Bihar ki rajdhani Patna hai. Patna ka purana naam Pataliputra tha, jo Maurya samrajya ki rajdhani tha.
Punjab ki rajdhani kaunsi hai?
Punjab ki rajdhani Chandigarh hai. Chandigarh Punjab aur Haryana dono ki sanyukt rajdhani hai aur ek kendra shasit pradesh bhi hai.
Haryana ki rajdhani kya hai?
Haryana ki rajdhani Chandigarh hai, jo Punjab ke saath share hoti hai.
Himachal Pradesh ki rajdhani kaunsi hai?
Himachal Pradesh ki rajdhani Shimla hai. Shimla pahadiyon me basa mashhoor shahar hai aur kabhi angrezon ki grishm-kaleen rajdhani tha.
Uttarakhand ki rajdhani kya hai?
Uttarakhand ki rajdhani Dehradun hai. Uttarakhand ko Devbhoomi bhi kehte hain kyunki wahan Char Dham jaise kai pavitra sthan hain.
Jharkhand ki rajdhani kaunsi hai?
Jharkhand ki rajdhani Ranchi hai. Jharkhand khadanon (mines) ke liye mashhoor hai.
Chhattisgarh ki rajdhani kya hai?
Chhattisgarh ki rajdhani Raipur hai. Chhattisgarh ko 'Dhaan ka katora' bhi kehte hain kyunki wahan chawal bahut hota hai.
Odisha ki rajdhani kaunsi hai?
Odisha ki rajdhani Bhubaneswar hai. Ise mandiron ka shahar bhi kehte hain.
Assam ki rajdhani kya hai?
Assam ki rajdhani Dispur hai, jo Guwahati shahar ka hissa hai. Assam chai ke bagaanon ke liye mashhoor hai.
Telangana ki rajdhani kaunsi hai?
Telangana ki rajdhani Hyderabad hai. Hyderabad ko motiyon ka shahar (City of Pearls) bhi kehte hain.
Andhra Pradesh ki rajdhani kya hai?
Andhra Pradesh ki rajdhani Amaravati hai. Hyderabad 2014 me rajya bantware ke baad Telangana ki rajdhani bani.
Goa ki rajdhani kaunsi hai?
Goa ki rajdhani Panaji hai. Goa kshetrafal me Bharat ka sabse chhota rajya hai aur apne samudra taton (beaches) ke liye mashhoor hai.
Bharat ka sabse bada rajya kaunsa hai kshetrafal me?
Kshetrafal ke hisaab se Bharat ka sabse bada rajya Rajasthan hai. Aur jansankhya ke hisaab se sabse bada rajya Uttar Pradesh hai.
Bharat ka sabse chhota rajya kaunsa hai?
Kshetrafal me Bharat ka sabse chhota rajya Goa hai.
Bharat me kul kitne rajya aur kendra shasit pradesh hain?
Bharat me kul 28 rajya aur 8 kendra shasit pradesh (Union Territories) hain. Delhi aur Jammu-Kashmir inme se pramukh hain.
Bharat ki rajdhani kya hai aur wo kab bani?
Bharat ki rajdhani New Delhi hai. 1911 me angrezon ne rajdhani Kolkata se Delhi sthanantarit ki thi, aur New Delhi aadhikarik roop se 1931 me rajdhani bani.
Bharat ki sabse pavitra aur lambi nadi kaunsi hai?
Ganga Bharat ki sabse pavitra aur sabse lambi nadi hai (lagbhag 2525 km). Ye Himalaya me Gangotri glacier se nikalti hai aur Bay of Bengal me mil jati hai.
Yamuna nadi kahan milti hai Ganga se?
Yamuna nadi Uttar Pradesh ke Prayagraj (purana naam Allahabad) me Ganga se milti hai. Wahan Saraswati nadi ke saath inka sangam 'Triveni Sangam' kehlata hai.
Dakshin Bharat ki sabse lambi nadi kaunsi hai?
Godavari Dakshin Bharat ki sabse lambi nadi hai (lagbhag 1465 km). Ise 'Dakshin Ganga' bhi kehte hain. Ye Maharashtra ke Nashik ke paas se nikalti hai.
Kaunsi nadi pashchim ki ore behti hai aur Arab Sagar me girti hai?
Narmada nadi pashchim ki ore behne wali pramukh nadi hai. Ye Madhya Pradesh ke Amarkantak se nikalti hai aur Gujarat me Arab Sagar me girti hai. Tapti nadi bhi pashchim ki ore behti hai.
Brahmaputra nadi ke baare me batao.
Brahmaputra nadi Tibet se nikalti hai, Arunachal Pradesh aur Assam se behti hui Bangladesh tak jati hai. Assam me isse har saal baadh aati hai kyunki ye bahut zyada paani laati hai.
Kaveri nadi kin rajyon se behti hai?
Kaveri nadi Karnataka ke Kodagu (Brahmagiri pahadi) se nikalti hai aur Karnataka aur Tamil Nadu se behti hui Bay of Bengal me girti hai. Ise Dakshin ki Ganga ke baad dusri pavitra nadi mana jata hai.
Sindhu nadi ke baare me kya jante ho?

Sindhu (Indus) nadi Tibet ke Mansarovar kshetra se nikalti hai aur Ladakh se hote hue Pakistan me behti hai. Bharat ka naam 'India' aur 'Hindu' shabd isi nadi ke naam se jude hain. Sindhu Ghati Sabhyata isi ke kinare vikasit hui thi.
Bharat ki sabse lambi nadi kaunsi hai?
Bharat ke andar behne wali sabse lambi nadi Ganga hai, lagbhag 2525 km. (Duniya ki sabse lambi nadi Neel (Nile) mani jati hai, lagbhag 6650 km.)
Krishna nadi kahan se nikalti hai?
Krishna nadi Maharashtra ke Satara jile ke Mahabaleshwar ke paas se nikalti hai aur Maharashtra, Karnataka, Telangana aur Andhra Pradesh se behti hui Bay of Bengal me girti hai.
Diwali kyun manayi jati hai?

Diwali burai par achhai ki jeet ka tyohar hai. Maanayta hai ki is din Bhagwan Ram 14 saal ke vanvaas ke baad Ayodhya laute the, to nagar-wasiyon ne diye jalakar unka swagat kiya tha. Is din Maa Lakshmi ki puja bhi hoti hai.
Holi ka tyohar kya sandesh deta hai?

Holi rangon ka tyohar hai jo vasant ritu ke aagman par manaya jata hai. Ye Holika-Prahlad ki katha se juda hai aur burai par bhakti aur achhai ki jeet ka sandesh deta hai. Is din log ek dusre par rang-gulal lagate hain.
Eid kyun manayi jati hai?

Eid-ul-Fitr Ramzan ke pavitra mahine ke rozon ke khatm hone par manayi jati hai. Is din log namaz padhte hain, sevaiyan khate hain aur gareebon ko zakat (daan) dete hain. Dusri badi Eid, Eid-ul-Adha (Bakrid), kurbani ki yaad me manayi jati hai.
Dussehra ka tyohar kis baat ki yaad dilata hai?

Dussehra Bhagwan Ram ki Ravan par vijay ki yaad me manaya jata hai. Is din Ravan ke putle jalaye jate hain. Ye Navratri ke baad Vijayadashami ke din aata hai aur burai par achhai ki jeet ka prateek hai.
Raksha Bandhan me kya hota hai?

Raksha Bandhan me behen apne bhai ki kalai par rakhi bandhti hai aur uski lambi umar ki kamna karti hai. Badle me bhai behen ki raksha ka vachan deta hai aur uphaar deta hai. Ye tyohar Shravan maas ki purnima ko manaya jata hai.
Pongal kiska tyohar hai aur kahan manaya jata hai?

Pongal Tamil Nadu ka pramukh fasal tyohar hai, jo January me 4 din manaya jata hai. Isme Soorya dev ko naye chawal ki fasal ke liye dhanyavaad diya jata hai aur mitti ke bartan me 'pongal' naam ki meethi dish banayi jati hai.
Onam kahan ka mashhoor tyohar hai?

Onam Kerala ka sabse bada tyohar hai. Maanayta hai ki is samay Raja Mahabali apni praja se milne aate hain. Is tyohar me phoolon ki rangoli (Pookalam), naav daud (Vallamkali) aur sadhya (paramparik bhojan) khaas hote hain.
Baisakhi kyun mahatvapurn hai?

Baisakhi Punjab ka fasal tyohar hai, jo April me rabi ki fasal katne ki khushi me manaya jata hai. Sikh dharm me iska khaas mahatva hai kyunki 1699 me isi din Guru Gobind Singh ji ne Khalsa Panth ki sthapna ki thi.
Chhath puja me kiski puja hoti hai?

Chhath puja me Soorya dev aur Chhathi Maiya ki puja hoti hai. Ye tyohar khaas taur par Bihar, Jharkhand aur purvi UP me manaya jata hai. Isme doobte aur ugte sooraj ko arghya diya jata hai aur vrat rakhne wale lagbhag 36 ghante ka kathin vrat rakhte hain.
Christmas kyun manaya jata hai?

Christmas 25 December ko Isa Masih (Jesus Christ) ke janm ki khushi me manaya jata hai. Is din church me prarthana hoti hai, Christmas tree sajaya jata hai aur Santa Claus bacchon ko tohfe deta hai — ye pyaar, shanti aur daya ka tyohar hai.
Navratri me kya hota hai?

Navratri me 9 din tak Maa Durga ke 9 roopon ki puja hoti hai. Gujarat me Garba aur Dandiya nritya khaas hota hai, aur West Bengal me Durga Puja bade pandalon me manayi jati hai. Saal me do baar Navratri aati hai — Chaitra aur Sharad maas me.
Guru Nanak Jayanti kise kehte hain?

Guru Nanak Jayanti (Gurpurab) Sikh dharm ke sansthapak Guru Nanak Dev ji ke janm din par manayi jati hai. Is din gurudwaron me kirtan hota hai, nagar kirtan nikalta hai aur langar (muft bhojan) batta hai.
Bharat kab azaad hua tha?
Bharat 15 August 1947 ko angrezon ki ghulami se azaad hua tha. Isiliye har saal 15 August ko Swatantrata Diwas manaya jata hai aur Pradhan Mantri Delhi ke Lal Qile se jhanda fehrate hain.
Gantantra Diwas kab aur kyun manaya jata hai?
Gantantra Diwas 26 January ko manaya jata hai kyunki 26 January 1950 ko Bharat ka Samvidhan lagu hua tha aur Bharat ek sampurn gantantra bana tha. Is din Delhi me bhavya parade hoti hai.
1857 ki kranti kya thi?

1857 ki kranti angrezon ke khilaf Bharat ki pehli badi baghawat thi, isiliye ise 'Pehla Swatantrata Sangram' bhi kehte hain. Isme Mangal Pandey, Rani Lakshmibai, Tantia Tope jaise veeron ne hissa liya tha. Ye Meerut se shuru hui thi.
Rani Lakshmibai kaun thi?

Rani Lakshmibai Jhansi ki rani thi aur 1857 ki kranti ki sabse mashhoor veerangana thi. Unhone angrezon se loha liya aur veergati prapt ki. Unki veerta par kaha gaya hai — 'Khoob ladi mardani, wo to Jhansi wali rani thi.'
Jallianwala Bagh hatyakand kya tha?

13 April 1919 ko Amritsar ke Jallianwala Bagh me General Dyer ke aadesh par angrez sainikon ne nihathi bheed par goliyan chalayi thi, jisme saikdon log mare gaye the. Ye ghatna azaadi ke sangram ki sabse dukhad ghatnaon me se ek hai.
Dandi March kya tha?

Dandi March (Namak Satyagrah) 1930 me Mahatma Gandhi ne shuru kiya tha. Unhone Ahmedabad ke Sabarmati Ashram se Dandi tak lagbhag 385 km paidal yatra karke samudra kinare namak banaya aur angrezon ke namak kanoon ko toda tha.
Bharat Chhodo Andolan kab hua tha?

Bharat Chhodo Andolan (Quit India Movement) 8 August 1942 ko Mahatma Gandhi ne Mumbai se shuru kiya tha. Isme unhone 'Karo ya Maro' ka naara diya tha aur angrezon se turant Bharat chhodne ki maang ki thi.
Bhagat Singh kaun the?

Bhagat Singh Bharat ke mahan krantikari the. Unhone Lala Lajpat Rai ki maut ka badla lene ke liye Saunders ko mara aur Delhi Assembly me bam phenka (kisi ko nuksan pahunchaye bina). Unhe 23 March 1931 ko sirf 23 saal ki umar me faansi di gayi thi. Unka naara tha — 'Inquilab Zindabad'.
Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel ko Loh Purush kyun kehte hain?

Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel ko unke majboot iradon aur faislon ke karan 'Loh Purush' (Iron Man) kaha jata hai. Azaadi ke baad unhone 560 se zyada riyasaton ko jodkar ek Bharat banaya. Wo Bharat ke pehle Grih Mantri aur Up-Pradhan Mantri the.
Samrat Ashok kaun the?

Samrat Ashok Maurya samrajya ke mahan raja the, Chandragupta Maurya ke pote the. Kalinga yuddh ki khoon-kharabi dekhkar unhone hinsa chhod di aur Buddha dharm apnakar shanti aur daya ka prachar kiya. Bharat ke rashtriya chinh me Ashok Stambh hi hai.
Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj ke baare me batao.

Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj 17vi sadi ke mahan yoddha the jinhone Maratha samrajya ki neev rakhi. Wo pahadi ilaakon me chhaapamar yuddh (guerrilla warfare) ke mahir the. Unka rajyabhishek 1674 me Raigad kile me hua tha.
Akbar ko mahan kyun kaha jata hai?

Akbar Mughal samrajya ke sabse prasiddh badshah the. Unhone sab dharmon ke prati samman ki neeti apnai, 'Din-e-Ilahi' aur sulah-e-kul ka vichar diya. Unke darbar me Birbal, Tansen aur Todar Mal jaise 'Navratna' the.
Indian National Congress ki sthapna kab hui?
Indian National Congress ki sthapna 1885 me hui thi. Iske pehle adhyaksh Womesh Chunder Bonnerjee the. Baad me yahi sangathan azaadi ke andolan ki sabse badi takat bana.
Bharat ka Samvidhan kab lagu hua?
Bharat ka Samvidhan 26 January 1950 ko lagu hua tha. Use Samvidhan Sabha ne 26 November 1949 ko apnaya (taiyaar karke paarit kiya) tha — isiliye 26 November ko Samvidhan Diwas manaya jata hai.
Bharat ke Samvidhan ke nirmata kise kaha jata hai?
Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar ko Bharat ke Samvidhan ka nirmata (Father of Indian Constitution) kaha jata hai. Wo Samvidhan ki Drafting Committee (Praroop Samiti) ke adhyaksh the.
Bharat ke pehle Rashtrapati kaun the?
Bharat ke pehle Rashtrapati Dr. Rajendra Prasad the. Wo Samvidhan Sabha ke adhyaksh bhi the.
Maulik Adhikar kya hote hain?

Maulik Adhikar (Fundamental Rights) wo buniyadi adhikar hain jo Samvidhan har nagrik ko deta hai — jaise samanata ka adhikar, bolne ki swatantrata, dharm ki swatantrata aur shiksha ka adhikar. Kul 6 Maulik Adhikar hain. Agar inka ullanghan ho to nagrik seedha court ja sakta hai.
Bharat me vote dene ki umar kitni hai?
Bharat me vote dene ki nyuntam umar 18 saal hai. 18 saal ka har Bharatiya nagrik chunav me matdaan kar sakta hai, chahe wo kisi bhi dharm, jaati ya ling ka ho.
Jeevan ka adhikar kis anuchhed me hai?
Jeevan aur vyaktigat swatantrata ka adhikar Samvidhan ke Anuchhed 21 (Article 21) me hai. Iske mutabik kanoon ki prakriya ke bina kisi ke jeevan ya swatantrata ko nahi chheena ja sakta.
Lok Sabha aur Rajya Sabha me kya farak hai?

Lok Sabha Sansad ka nichla sadan hai — iske sadasya (MP) janta seedha chunav se chun ti hai aur kul 543 chune hue sadasya hote hain. Rajya Sabha upar ka sadan hai — iske sadasya rajyon ki vidhan sabhaon dwara chune jate hain aur ye kabhi puri tarah bhang nahi hoti.
Samvidhan ki prastavana (Preamble) kya hoti hai?

Prastavana Samvidhan ki bhoomika (introduction) hai jo uske moolyon ko batati hai. Isme Bharat ko ek samprabhu, samajwadi, dharmnirpeksh aur loktantrik gantantra bataya gaya hai, aur nagrikon ko nyay, swatantrata, samanata aur bandhuta ka vada kiya gaya hai.
Duniya ka sabse lamba likhit samvidhan kis desh ka hai?
Bharat ka Samvidhan duniya ka sabse lamba likhit samvidhan hai. Isiliye ise taiyaar karne me lagbhag 2 saal 11 mahine lage the.
Duniya me kul kitne mahadweep (continents) hain?
Duniya me kul 7 mahadweep hain: Asia, Africa, North America, South America, Antarctica, Europe aur Australia. Asia sabse bada mahadweep hai aur Bharat Asia me hi hai.
Duniya ka sabse bada mahasagar kaunsa hai?
Prashant Mahasagar (Pacific Ocean) duniya ka sabse bada aur sabse gehra mahasagar hai. Duniya me kul 5 mahasagar mane jate hain — Prashant, Atalantic, Hind, Arctic aur Dakshini (Southern).
Duniya ka sabse bada desh kaunsa hai?
Kshetrafal me duniya ka sabse bada desh Russia hai. Sabse chhota desh Vatican City hai, jo Italy ke Rome shahar ke andar sthit hai.
Duniya ki sabse unchi choti kaunsi hai?
Duniya ki sabse unchi choti Mount Everest hai, jiski unchai lagbhag 8848 meter hai. Ye Nepal aur Tibet (China) ki seema par Himalaya me hai. Nepal me ise Sagarmatha kehte hain.
Duniya ka sabse bada registan kaunsa hai?
Sahara duniya ka sabse bada garam registan hai, jo Africa mahadweep ke uttar me hai. (Thande registan me Antarctica sabse bada hai, par aam taur par garam registan me Sahara ka naam aata hai.)
Japan ko ugte sooraj ka desh kyun kehte hain?
Japan ko 'Ughte Sooraj ka Desh' (Land of the Rising Sun) kehte hain kyunki Asia ke purab me sthit hone ke karan wahan sooraj sabse pehle ugta hua dikhai deta hai. Japan ki rajdhani Tokyo hai.
Australia ki rajdhani kya hai?
Australia ki rajdhani Canberra hai. Sydney uska sabse mashhoor aur bada shahar hai, par rajdhani Canberra hi hai.
America (USA) ki rajdhani kya hai?
America (United States of America) ki rajdhani Washington D.C. hai. New York uska sabse bada shahar hai, rajdhani nahi.
France ki rajdhani aur wahan ki mashhoor cheez kya hai?
France ki rajdhani Paris hai. Paris me sthit Eiffel Tower duniya bhar me mashhoor hai, jo 1889 me banaya gaya tha.
China ki rajdhani kya hai aur wahan ki mashhoor deewar kaunsi hai?
China ki rajdhani Beijing hai. China ki Mahan Deewar (Great Wall of China) duniya ki sabse lambi manav-nirmit rachna hai, jo hazaron kilometer lambi hai.
Bharat ke padosi desh kaun kaun se hain?
Bharat ke padosi desh hain: Pakistan, Afghanistan, China, Nepal, Bhutan, Bangladesh aur Myanmar. Samudra ke paar Dakshin me Sri Lanka bhi paas ka padosi hai.
Suraj kis disha me ugta hai aur kis disha me doobta hai?
Suraj hamesha purab (East) disha me ugta hai aur pashchim (West) disha me doobta hai. Asliyat me ye Prithvi ke apni dhuri par ghumne ke karan dikhai deta hai.
Prithvi par kul kitne desh hain?
Duniya me lagbhag 195 desh mane jate hain (Sanyukt Rashtra ke 193 sadasya desh aur 2 paryavekshak desh). Ye ginti samay ke saath thodi badal sakti hai.
Sooraj kya hai — grah hai ya tara?

Sooraj ek tara (star) hai, grah nahi. Ye humare saur mandal ka kendra hai aur Prithvi se lagbhag 15 crore km door hai. Isme itni garmi aur roshni hai kyunki iske andar hydrogen gas lagatar helium me badalti rehti hai (nuclear fusion).
Photosynthesis kya hota hai?

Photosynthesis (Prakash Sanshleshan) wo prakriya hai jisme ped-paudhe sooraj ki roshni, paani aur hawa ki carbon dioxide se apna khana (glucose) banate hain aur badle me oxygen chhodte hain. Yahi oxygen hum saans me lete hain, isiliye ped lagana zaroori hai.
Paani ka chemical formula kya hai?
Paani ka chemical formula H₂O hai. Iska matlab hai paani ke ek anu me hydrogen ke 2 parmanu aur oxygen ka 1 parmanu hota hai.
Paani kitne degree par ubalta aur jamta hai?
Samanya dabav par paani 100°C par ubalta hai aur 0°C par jamkar barf ban jata hai. Pahadon par unchai ke karan dabav kam hota hai, isiliye wahan paani 100°C se pehle hi ubalne lagta hai.
Gravity kya hai aur ise kisne samjhaya?

Gravity (Gurutvakarshan) wo takat hai jo har cheez ko Prithvi apni ore kheenchti hai — isiliye koi cheez upar phenko to neeche girti hai. Ise vistar se samjhane ka shrey vaigyanik Isaac Newton ko jata hai; katha hai ki seb ke girne ko dekhkar unhe ye vichar aaya tha.
Insaan ke dil ke kitne hisse (chambers) hote hain?

Insaan ke dil me 4 chambers (khand) hote hain — 2 upar wale (atria) aur 2 neeche wale (ventricles). Dil ek pump ki tarah pure shareer me khoon pahunchata hai aur ek din me lagbhag 1 lakh baar dhadakta hai.
Khoon ka rang laal kyun hota hai?
Khoon ka rang laal haemoglobin ke karan hota hai. Haemoglobin laal khoon ke kanon (RBC) me paya jane wala protein hai jisme loha (iron) hota hai — yahi oxygen ko pure shareer me le jata hai.
Hum saans kyun lete hain?

Hum saans isliye lete hain taaki shareer ko oxygen mile. Oxygen khane se urja banane ke kaam aati hai. Saans lene ka kaam humare fefde (lungs) karte hain — hawa naak se fefdon me jati hai aur carbon dioxide bahar nikalti hai.
Indradhanush me kitne rang hote hain?

Indradhanush (rainbow) me 7 rang hote hain: baingani, jamuni (indigo), neela, hara, peela, narangi aur laal. Ye rang tab dikhte hain jab baarish ke baad sooraj ki roshni paani ki boondon se guzarkar alag-alag rangon me bant jati hai.
Saur mandal me kitne grah hain?

Humare saur mandal me 8 grah hain: Budh (Mercury), Shukra (Venus), Prithvi (Earth), Mangal (Mars), Brihaspati (Jupiter), Shani (Saturn), Arun (Uranus) aur Varun (Neptune). Pluto ko ab 'bauna grah' (dwarf planet) mana jata hai.
Sabse bada grah kaunsa hai?
Brihaspati (Jupiter) saur mandal ka sabse bada grah hai. Ye itna bada hai ki isme 1300 se zyada Prithviyan sama sakti hain. Sabse chhota grah Budh (Mercury) hai.
Mangal grah ko laal grah kyun kehte hain?
Mangal (Mars) ko laal grah kehte hain kyunki uski mitti aur chattanon me lohe ke jung (iron oxide) ki matra zyada hai, jisse wo laal-narangi dikhai deta hai.
Shukra grah ki khaas baat kya hai?

Shukra (Venus) saur mandal ka sabse garam grah hai aur aasmaan me sabse chamakdar dikhai deta hai. Ise 'Bhor ka Tara' aur 'Shaam ka Tara' bhi kehte hain kyunki ye subah-shaam sabse zyada chamakta hai.
Prithvi ko neela grah kyun kehte hain?
Prithvi ko neela grah kehte hain kyunki uski satah ka lagbhag 71% hissa paani se dhaka hai. Antriksh se dekhne par ye paani neela dikhai deta hai. Prithvi hi ekmatra gyat grah hai jahan jeevan hai.
Chand par hawa kyun nahi hai?

Chand ka gurutvakarshan (gravity) bahut kam hai, isiliye wo hawa (vatavaran) ko rok nahi pata — wahan vatavaran lagbhag hai hi nahi. Isi karan Chand par awaaz nahi ja sakti aur din-raat ke taapman me bahut farak hota hai.
Roshni ki speed kitni hoti hai?
Roshni ki speed lagbhag 3 lakh kilometer prati second (300,000 km/s) hoti hai — ye duniya ki sabse tez speed hai. Sooraj ki roshni ko Prithvi tak pahunchne me lagbhag 8 minute 20 second lagte hain.
Prithvi sooraj ke chaaron or ek chakkar kitne din me lagati hai?

Prithvi sooraj ke chaaron or ek chakkar lagbhag 365 din aur 6 ghante me lagati hai — isi se ek saal banta hai. Bache hue 6 ghante har 4 saal me judkar ek extra din banta hai, use Leap Year (adhik varsh) kehte hain jisme February 29 din ki hoti hai.
Mausam (ritu) kyun badalte hain?
Mausam Prithvi ki dhuri ke jhukav aur uske sooraj ke chaaron or ghumne ke karan badalte hain. Jab humara hissa sooraj ki ore jhuka hota hai to garmi hoti hai, aur jab door hota hai to sardi.
Din aur raat kyun hote hain?

Prithvi apni dhuri (axis) par lagbhag 24 ghante me ek chakkar ghumti hai. Jo hissa sooraj ke saamne hota hai wahan din hota hai aur peeche wale hisse me raat. Isi ghumav ko Prithvi ka 'rotation' kehte hain.
Bharat ka rashtriya jhanda kaisa hai?

Bharat ka rashtriya jhanda 'Tiranga' hai. Isme upar kesariya, beech me safed aur neeche hari patti hoti hai. Beech me neele rang ka Ashok Chakra hota hai jisme 24 teeliyan (spokes) hoti hain. Kesariya tyag, safed shanti aur hari samriddhi ka prateek hai.
Bharat ka rashtragaan kaunsa hai aur kisne likha?
Bharat ka rashtragaan 'Jana Gana Mana' hai, jise Gurudev Rabindranath Tagore ne likha tha. Ise gaane ka aadhikarik samay lagbhag 52 second hai.
Bharat ka rashtriya geet kaunsa hai?
Bharat ka rashtriya geet 'Vande Mataram' hai, jise Bankim Chandra Chatterjee ne apne upanyas 'Anandamath' me likha tha.
Bharat ka rashtriya pashu aur pakshi kaun se hain?
Bharat ka rashtriya pashu Bengal Tiger (baagh) hai aur rashtriya pakshi Mor (Indian Peacock) hai. Rashtriya phool kamal aur rashtriya ped bargad hai.
Bharat ki pehli mahila Rashtrapati kaun thi?
Bharat ki pehli mahila Rashtrapati Pratibha Patil thi, jo 2007 me Rashtrapati bani thi.
Lal Qila kahan hai aur kisne banwaya?
Lal Qila Delhi me hai aur ise Mughal badshah Shah Jahan ne banwaya tha. Har saal 15 August ko Bharat ke Pradhan Mantri yahin se jhanda fehrate hain aur desh ko sambodhit karte hain.
Qutub Minar ke baare me batao.
Qutub Minar Delhi me sthit lagbhag 73 meter unchi minar hai, jo Bharat ki sabse unchi eent ki minar hai. Ise Qutb-ud-din Aibak ne shuru karwaya tha aur Iltutmish ne pura kiya tha.
Bharat ka rashtriya khel kaunsa hai?

Sach ye hai ki Bharat ka koi aadhikarik rashtriya khel ghoshit nahi hai. Hockey ko aksar rashtriya khel mana jata hai kyunki Bharat ne hockey me 8 Olympic swarn padak jeete hain, par sarkari taur par koi khel ghoshit nahi hai.
Antriksh me jane wale pehle Bharatiya kaun the?

Antriksh me jane wale pehle Bharatiya Rakesh Sharma the, jo 1984 me Soviet sangh ke mission me gaye the. Unke mashhoor shabd the — 'Saare Jahan Se Achha', jab unse pucha gaya ki Bharat antriksh se kaisa dikhta hai.

English me formal letter ke main hisse kya hote hain?

Formal letter ke mukhya hisse (oopar se neeche):
1. Sender's Address — bhejnewale ka pata (upar)
2. Date — taareekh
3. Receiver's Address — panewale ka pata aur pad (To, The Principal...)
4. Subject — vishay ek line me
5. Salutation — Respected Sir/Madam
6. Body — 3 hisse: parichay, mukhya baat, nishkarsh
7. Closing — Thanking you, Yours faithfully/obediently
8. Name aur signature

Yaad rakho: formal letter hamesha saaf, chhota aur vinamr bhasha me hota hai.
English grammar me Noun kya hota hai?

Noun kisi vyakti, sthan, vastu ya bhav ka naam hota hai.
Examples: Ram (vyakti), Delhi (sthan), book (vastu), happiness (bhav).
Vaakya me dekho: 'Ram is reading a book in Delhi.' — Ram, book aur Delhi teeno Noun hain.
Pronoun kya hota hai example ke saath batao.

Pronoun wo shabd hai jo Noun ki jagah istemal hota hai, taaki naam baar-baar na dohrana pade.
Examples: I, you, he, she, it, we, they, him, her.
Vaakya: 'Ravi is my friend. He is very kind.' — yahan 'He' Ravi ke liye Pronoun hai.
Verb kya hoti hai? Samjhao.

Verb wo shabd hai jo kisi kaam ya sthiti ko batata hai — vaakya ki jaan Verb hi hoti hai.
Examples: run, eat, write, sleep, is, are.
Vaakya: 'Birds fly in the sky.' — 'fly' Verb hai kyunki ye kaam bata raha hai.
Adjective kya hota hai?

Adjective wo shabd hai jo Noun ya Pronoun ki khaasiyat (quality) batata hai.
Examples: big, small, beautiful, five, honest.
Vaakya: 'She has a beautiful dress.' aur 'I have five pens.' — beautiful aur five Adjective hain.
English me 'a', 'an' aur 'the' kab use karte hain?

Ye Articles hain:
- 'a': consonant awaaz wale aam naam se pehle — a book, a car
- 'an': vowel awaaz (a, e, i, o, u) se shuru shabdon se pehle — an apple, an umbrella, an hour
- 'the': khaas/nishchit cheez ke liye — the sun, the Taj Mahal, the book on the table (wahi wali kitab)
Tip: 'an hour' isliye kyunki hour ki awaaz vowel 'au' se shuru hoti hai.
Present Simple Tense kaise banta hai?

Present Simple Tense roz ke kaam aur aam sach ke liye use hota hai.
Formula: Subject + Verb (pehla roop) + Object
- I play cricket. / We study daily.
- He/She ke saath Verb me 's' ya 'es' judta hai: He plays cricket. She goes to school.
Signal words: daily, always, every day.
Past Simple Tense samjhao example ke saath.

Past Simple Tense bite hue samay ke pure ho chuke kaam ke liye hota hai.
Formula: Subject + Verb (dusra roop) + Object
Examples: I went to school yesterday. She cooked food. They played well.
Signal words: yesterday, last night, last year, ago.
Future Simple Tense kaise banega?

Future Simple Tense aane wale samay ke kaam ke liye hota hai.
Formula: Subject + will + Verb (pehla roop) + Object
Examples: I will help you. We will go to Delhi tomorrow. It will rain today.
Signal words: tomorrow, next week, soon.
Present Continuous Tense kya hai?

Present Continuous Tense us kaam ke liye hai jo abhi, is samay ho raha hai.
Formula: Subject + is/am/are + Verb-ing + Object
Examples: I am reading. She is cooking. They are playing.
Signal words: now, at this moment, look!, listen!
English me plural banane ke rules batao.

Plural banane ke mukhya rules:
1. Aam taur par 's' lagao: book→books, pen→pens
2. s, ss, x, ch, sh par khatm ho to 'es': bus→buses, box→boxes, watch→watches
3. Consonant + y par khatm ho to y hatao, 'ies': baby→babies, city→cities
4. Kuch shabd pura badal jate hain: man→men, child→children, tooth→teeth, foot→feet
5. Kuch waise hi rehte hain: sheep→sheep, deer→deer
'Go' verb ke teen roop kya hain?

'Go' ke teen roop: Go (pehla) — Went (dusra/past) — Gone (teesra/past participle).
Examples: I go to school. (aaj)
I went to school yesterday. (kal)
I have gone to school. (ja chuka hoon)
'Eat' aur 'Write' ke teen-teen roop batao.

Eat ke roop: Eat — Ate — Eaten
Example: I eat food. / I ate food. / I have eaten food.

Write ke roop: Write — Wrote — Written
Example: She writes a letter. / She wrote a letter. / She has written a letter.
Synonym kya hota hai? Kuch examples do.

Synonyms wo shabd hote hain jinka matlab ek jaisa ya lagbhag ek jaisa hota hai.
Examples:
- Happy = Glad, Joyful
- Big = Large, Huge
- Fast = Quick, Rapid
- Start = Begin
- Beautiful = Lovely, Pretty
Synonyms seekhne se tumhari English aur achhi aur rang-birangi ho jati hai.
Antonym kya hota hai? Examples do.

Antonyms wo shabd hote hain jinka matlab ek dusre ke bilkul ulta hota hai.
Examples:
- Hot × Cold
- Day × Night
- Happy × Sad
- Begin × End
- Rich × Poor
- Always × Never
Sentence me Subject aur Predicate kya hota hai?

Har sentence ke do hisse hote hain:
- Subject: jiske baare me baat ho rahi hai
- Predicate: jo uske baare me kaha gaya hai
Example: 'The dog is barking loudly.'
Subject = The dog, Predicate = is barking loudly.
Pehchan: 'Kaun/kya?' ka jawab Subject hota hai.
Question mark aur full stop kab lagate hain?

Full Stop (.): jab vaakya pura ho jaye — 'I am a student.'
Question Mark (?): jab koi sawal pucha jaye — 'What is your name?'
Exclamation Mark (!): hairani, khushi ya tez bhava par — 'Wow! What a beautiful place!'
Comma (,): chhota sa viram, cheezon ki list me — 'I bought pen, pencil and book.'
Capital letter kab use karte hain English me?

Capital letter in jagahon par lagta hai:
1. Sentence ki shuruaat me: 'The sun rises in the east.'
2. Naamon me: Ram, India, Delhi, Ganga
3. 'I' (main) hamesha capital hota hai
4. Dino, mahino aur tyoharon ke naam: Monday, January, Diwali
5. Bhashaon ke naam: English, Hindi
'Their', 'There' aur 'They're' me kya farak hai?

Teeno ki awaaz ek jaisi hai par matlab alag:
- Their = unka/unki (kabza): 'Their house is big.'
- There = wahan (jagah): 'Sit there.'
- They're = They are ka chhota roop: 'They're my friends.'
Tip: jagah ke liye 'there', kabze ke liye 'their', aur 'they are' keh sakte ho to 'they're'.
'Your' aur 'You're' me farak batao.

- Your = tumhara/tumhari: 'Your book is here.'
- You're = You are ka chhota roop: 'You're a good student.'
Pehchan ka tareeka: agar 'you are' rakhkar vaakya sahi lage to 'you're', warna 'your'.
Has aur Have kab use karte hain?

Dono ka matlab hai 'ke paas hai / rakhta hai':
- Has: He, She, It aur ek naam (singular) ke saath — 'He has a car.' 'Rita has a doll.'
- Have: I, You, We, They aur bahuvachan ke saath — 'I have a pen.' 'They have two dogs.'
Yaad rakho: He/She/It → has, baaki sab → have.
Is, am, are ka sahi use batao.

- Am: sirf 'I' ke saath — I am happy.
- Is: He, She, It aur ek cheez/vyakti ke saath — She is kind. It is hot.
- Are: You, We, They aur bahuvachan ke saath — You are late. They are friends. We are students.
Asaan trick: I–am, ek–is, zyada–are.
Preposition kya hota hai? In, on, at ka use batao.

Preposition sambandh batane wale shabd hain — in, on, at, under, behind.
- In: andar / bade samay ke liye — in the box, in January, in 2026
- On: upar satah par / din ke liye — on the table, on Monday
- At: khaas jagah ya samay ke liye — at home, at 5 o'clock
Examples: 'The book is on the table.' 'He is at home.'
Ek sentence ko negative kaise banate hain?

Negative banane ke rules:
- Present Simple: do not (don't) / does not (doesn't) + Verb ka pehla roop
  'I play.' → 'I do not play.' / 'He plays.' → 'He does not play.'
- Past Simple: did not (didn't) + pehla roop — 'She went.' → 'She did not go.'
- Is/am/are ke saath 'not' jodo: 'He is not happy.'
Dhyan do: does/did aane ke baad Verb hamesha pehle roop me rehta hai.
Sawal wala sentence (interrogative) kaise banate hain?

Sawal banane ke tareeke:
- Is/am/are ko aage lao: 'He is happy.' → 'Is he happy?'
- Present Simple me Do/Does aage: 'You like tea.' → 'Do you like tea?' / 'She sings.' → 'Does she sing?'
- Past me Did: 'They came.' → 'Did they come?'
- Wh-words (What, Where, When, Why, How) sabse aage: 'What is your name?' 'Where do you live?'
Direct aur Indirect Speech kya hota hai basic me?

Direct Speech: kisi ki kahi baat waise ki waisi, quotes me — Ram said, "I am busy."
Indirect Speech: wahi baat apne shabdon me, bina quotes ke — Ram said that he was busy.
Badlaav: 'I' bolne wale ke hisaab se badalta hai, tense ek kadam peeche jata hai (am→was), aur 'that' judta hai.
Degrees of Comparison kya hoti hain?

Adjective ki teen degrees hoti hain:
1. Positive: tall, big, good
2. Comparative (do ki tulna): taller, bigger, better — 'Ram is taller than Shyam.'
3. Superlative (sabse): tallest, biggest, best — 'Ram is the tallest in the class.'
Rules: chhote shabdon me -er/-est, bade shabdon me more/most — beautiful → more beautiful → most beautiful. Good ki degrees aniyamit hain: good–better–best.
'Since' aur 'For' me kya farak hai?

Dono samay ke liye aate hain, khaas taur par Perfect tenses me:
- Since: samay ka shuru wala bindu (point) — since Monday, since 2020, since morning
- For: samay ki kul lambaai (period) — for two days, for five years, for an hour
Example: 'I have lived here since 2020.' / 'I have lived here for six years.'
Active aur Passive Voice kya hai simple me?

Active Voice: jab Subject khud kaam kare — 'Ram wrote a letter.' (Ram ne kaam kiya)
Passive Voice: jab kaam (Object) aage aa jaye — 'A letter was written by Ram.'
Passive ka formula: Object + is/was + Verb ka teesra roop + by + Subject.
Present: 'The room is cleaned daily.' Past: 'The match was won by India.'
Hindi vyakaran me Sangya kya hoti hai?

Kisi vyakti, vastu, sthan ya bhav ke naam ko Sangya kehte hain.
Examples: Ram (vyakti), Delhi (sthan), Kursi (vastu), Khushi (bhav).
Sangya ke mukhya 3 bhed: Vyakti-vachak (Ram, Ganga), Jaati-vachak (ladka, nadi), Bhav-vachak (mithaas, lambaai).
Sarvanam kya hota hai examples do.

Sangya ki jagah istemal hone wale shabdon ko Sarvanam kehte hain.
Examples: main, tum, aap, wo, ye, hum, usne, mera.
Vaakya: 'Ravi aaya aur usne khana khaya.' — yahan 'usne' Sarvanam hai jo Ravi ki jagah aaya.
Visheshan kya hota hai samjhao.

Jo shabd Sangya ya Sarvanam ki visheshata bataye, use Visheshan kehte hain.
Examples: bada, kaala, paanch, bahut.
Vaakya: 'Mere paas ek laal car hai aur paanch kitabein hain.' — 'laal' aur 'paanch' Visheshan hain.
Kriya kya hoti hai Hindi me?

Jis shabd se kisi kaam ka hona ya karna samajh aaye, use Kriya kehte hain.
Examples: khana, sona, daudna, padhna, hasna.
Vaakya: 'Baccha khel raha hai.' — 'khel raha hai' Kriya hai. Bina Kriya ke vaakya pura nahi hota.
Ling kya hota hai? Pulling aur Striling batao.

Ling se pata chalta hai ki Sangya purush jaati ki hai ya stree jaati ki.
- Pulling: ladka, ghoda, raja, beta
- Striling: ladki, ghodi, rani, beti
Vaakya se pehchan: 'Ladka khelta hai' (pulling), 'Ladki khelti hai' (striling) — kriya ka roop bhi ling ke hisaab se badalta hai.
Vachan kya hota hai? Ekvachan aur Bahuvachan batao.

Vachan se sangya ki sankhya ka pata chalta hai:
- Ekvachan: ek cheez — kitab, ladka, phool
- Bahuvachan: ek se zyada — kitabein, ladke, phool (phool dono me ek jaisa rehta hai)
Examples: 'Ek kitab mez par hai.' / 'Kai kitabein mez par hain.'
Kaal kya hota hai? Teen kaal batao.

Kriya ke jis roop se kaam ke samay ka pata chale, use Kaal kehte hain. Teen mukhya Kaal:
1. Vartaman Kaal (abhi): Ram padhta hai.
2. Bhoot Kaal (beeta samay): Ram ne padha.
3. Bhavishya Kaal (aane wala samay): Ram padhega.
Muhavra kya hota hai? 5 mashhoor muhavre arth ke saath do.

Muhavra wo shabd-samuh hai jiska arth shabdon ke seedhe arth se alag, khaas arth hota hai.
1. Aankhon ka taara = bahut pyaara
2. Naak katna = beizzati hona
3. Haath batana = madad karna
4. Din dugni raat chauguni tarakki = bahut tez unnati
5. Ulta chor kotwal ko daante = apni galti doosre par dalna
Lokokti aur Muhavre me kya farak hai?

- Muhavra: chhota shabd-samuh hota hai jo vaakya ka hissa bankar aata hai — 'usne mera haath bataya.' Ye adhura vaakya hota hai.
- Lokokti (Kahawat): pura vaakya hoti hai jo jeevan ki seekh deti hai — 'Jaisi karni waisi bharni.' Ye apne aap me pura sach hota hai.
Seedha farak: muhavra tukda hai, lokokti pura vaakya.
Samas kya hota hai basic me batao.

Do ya do se zyada shabdon ke mel se bana chhota shabd Samas kehlata hai.
Examples:
- Rajputra = Raja ka putra
- Neelkamal = Neela hai jo kamal
- Mata-Pita = Mata aur Pita (Dvandva samas)
- Trilok = Teen lokon ka samuh
Samas se bhasha chhoti aur sundar ho jati hai.
Sandhi kya hoti hai? Example do.

Do varnon (aksharon) ke mel se hone wale badlaav ko Sandhi kehte hain.
Examples:
- Vidya + Aalaya = Vidyalaya (a + aa = aa)
- Surya + Uday = Suryoday (a + u = o)
- Maha + Atma = Mahatma (aa + aa = aa)
Sandhi teen prakar ki hoti hai: Swar Sandhi, Vyanjan Sandhi aur Visarg Sandhi.
Upasarg kya hota hai examples ke saath?

Jo shabdांश kisi shabd se pehle judkar uska arth badal de, use Upasarg kehte hain.
Examples:
- 'Pra' + Haar = Prahaar, 'Vi' + Haar = Vihaar
- 'Anu' + Bhav = Anubhav
- 'Be' + Kaar = Bekaar
- 'Bad' + Naam = Badnaam
Upasarg judne se naya shabd aur naya arth ban jata hai.
Pratyay kya hota hai? Samjhao.

Jo shabdांश kisi shabd ke peeche (baad me) judkar naya shabd banaye, use Pratyay kehte hain.
Examples:
- Bachcha + Pan = Bachpan
- Meetha + Aas = Mithaas
- Likh + Aai = Likhaai
- Samajh + Daar = Samajhdaar
Farq yaad rakho: Upasarg pehle judta hai, Pratyay peeche.
Paryayvachi shabd kya hote hain? Kuch examples do.

Ek hi arth wale alag-alag shabdon ko Paryayvachi (samanarthi) shabd kehte hain.
- Sooraj: Surya, Ravi, Bhanu, Aaditya
- Paani: Jal, Neer, Vaari
- Aankh: Netra, Nayan, Lochan
- Maa: Janani, Mata, Amba
- Ped: Vriksh, Taru
Vilom shabd kya hote hain? Examples do.

Ek dusre ke ulte arth wale shabdon ko Vilom shabd kehte hain.
- Din × Raat
- Sukh × Dukh
- Ameer × Gareeb
- Upar × Neeche
- Janm × Mrityu
- Sach × Jhooth
Karak kya hota hai? Karta karak batao.

Sangya ya Sarvanam ka Kriya ke saath jo sambandh hota hai, use Karak kehte hain. Kul 8 Karak hote hain.
Karta Karak: jo kaam kare — iska chinh 'ne' hota hai.
Example: 'Ram ne khana khaya.' — Ram Karta hai.
Dusre karak: Karm (ko), Karan (se/dwara), Sampradan (ke liye), Apadan (se — alag hona), Sambandh (ka/ki), Adhikaran (me/par), Sambodhan (he/are).
Vakya ke kitne bhed hote hain arth ke aadhar par?

Arth ke aadhar par vaakya ke 8 bhed hote hain, mukhya ye hain:
1. Vidhan-vachak: Ram school jata hai.
2. Prashn-vachak: Tum kahan ja rahe ho?
3. Aagya-vachak: Yahan baitho.
4. Nishchay... (Iccha-vachak): Bhagwan kare tum safal ho.
5. Vismay-vachak: Wah! Kitna sundar hai!
6. Nishedh-vachak: Wahan mat jao.
7. Sanket-vachak: Agar mehnat karoge to safal hoge.
8. Sandeh-vachak: Shayad wo aaye.
Tatsam aur Tadbhava shabd me kya farak hai?

- Tatsam: Sanskrit ke wo shabd jo Hindi me bina badle waise ke waise use hote hain — Agni, Jal, Vriksh, Raatri.
- Tadbhava: Sanskrit se badalkar bane shabd — Aag (Agni se), Paani (Paaniya se), Ped... (Vriksh ka tadbhava nahi), Kaan (Karn se), Haath (Hast se).
Asaan pehchan: jo shabd kathin aur shuddh Sanskrit jaisa lage wo Tatsam, jo roz ki boli jaisa lage wo aksar Tadbhava.
Sangya ke bhed kitne hote hain?

Sangya ke mukhya 5 bhed mane jate hain:
1. Vyakti-vachak: khaas naam — Ganga, Mahatma Gandhi
2. Jaati-vachak: puri jaati — nadi, aadmi, shahar
3. Bhav-vachak: bhav/gun — sachchai, lambaai, bachpan
4. Samuh-vachak: samooh — sena, bheed, kaksha
5. Dravya-vachak: naap-tol wali cheez — sona, doodh, tel
Sarvanam ke bhed batao chhote me.

Sarvanam ke 6 bhed hote hain:
1. Purush-vachak: main, tum, wo
2. Nishchay-vachak: ye, wo (khaas ki ore ishara)
3. Anishchay-vachak: koi, kuch
4. Sambandh-vachak: jo — so
5. Prashn-vachak: kaun, kya
6. Nij-vachak: apna, khud, svayam
'Avyay' kya hote hain?

Avyay wo shabd hain jo ling, vachan ya kaal ke karan kabhi nahi badalte — hamesha ek jaise rehte hain.
Examples: aaj, kal, yahan, wahan, dheere, bahut, aur, par, kintu.
Vaakya: 'Wo kal aayega.' aur 'Wo kal aayi thi.' — dono me 'kal' waisa ka waisa hai, isiliye 'kal' Avyay hai.
Vartani (spelling) ki aam galtiyon se kaise bachein?

Vartani sudharne ke tips:
1. Roz 10 naye shabdon ki shuddh vartani likhkar abhyas karo
2. Mushkil shabdon ko tod-todkar yaad karo: jaise 'Vidyalaya' = Vidya + Aalaya
3. Zyada padho — sahi shabdon ko dekhne se aankh aadi ho jati hai
4. Aam galtiyon par dhyan: 'mein' aur 'mai' ka farak, badi aur chhoti matra (i/ee, u/oo)
5. Likhne ke baad ek baar zaroor padhkar jaancho
Hindi se English: 'Mera naam Aarav hai' ka anuvaad karo.

'Mera naam Aarav hai' ka English anuvaad: 'My name is Aarav.'
Seekh: 'Mera' = My, 'naam' = name, 'hai' = is.
'I am going to school' ka Hindi anuvaad kya hoga?

'I am going to school' ka Hindi anuvaad: 'Main school ja raha hoon.' (ladki ke liye — 'ja rahi hoon')
Seekh: 'going' = ja raha, isliye ye Present Continuous tense hai.
'Wo roz subah jaldi uthta hai' ko English me badlo.

English: 'He wakes up early every morning.'
Seekh: 'roz' = every day/every morning, aur He ke saath verb me 's' judta hai — wakes.
'She is my best friend' ka Hindi me anuvaad karo.

Hindi: 'Wo meri sabse achhi dost hai.'
Seekh: 'best' = sabse achha/sabse achhi, 'friend' = dost. 'She' ke liye 'wo' aur dost striling me 'achhi' aaya.
'Mujhe paani peena hai' English me kaise kahenge?

English: 'I want to drink water.' ya 'I have to drink water.'
Seekh: 'Mujhe ... hai' wale vaakyon me aksar 'I want to' ya 'I have to' lagta hai — 'Mujhe padhna hai' = 'I have to study.'
'The sun rises in the east' ka Hindi anuvaad do.

Hindi: 'Sooraj purab me ugta hai.'
Seekh: 'rises' = ugta hai, 'east' = purab. Ye aam sach hai isiliye Present Simple tense use hua hai.
'Tum kahan rehte ho?' ko English me translate karo.

English: 'Where do you live?'
Seekh: 'kahan' = where, sawal hai isiliye 'do' aage aaya — Where + do + you + live?
'I have two brothers' ka Hindi anuvaad kya hai?

Hindi: 'Mere do bhai hain.'
Seekh: English me 'I have' kehte hain par Hindi me 'mere ... hain' banta hai — anuvaad shabd-dar-shabd nahi, bhaav ke hisaab se hota hai.
'Kripya darwaza band karo' English me kaise kahenge?

English: 'Please close the door.'
Seekh: 'Kripya' = Please, 'band karo' = close. Aagya wale vaakya (request/order) me verb se shuruaat hoti hai.
'It is raining today' ka Hindi me anuvaad karo.

Hindi: 'Aaj baarish ho rahi hai.'
Seekh: 'raining' = baarish ho rahi, 'today' = aaj. English me mausam ke liye 'It' se vaakya shuru hota hai.
'Main kal Delhi jaunga' ko English me badlo.

English: 'I will go to Delhi tomorrow.'
Seekh: 'jaunga' = will go (bhavishya), 'kal' (aane wala) = tomorrow. Dhyan do: beete hue kal ke liye 'yesterday' hota hai, aane wale kal ke liye 'tomorrow'.
'Please give me your book' ka Hindi anuvaad do.

Hindi: 'Kripya mujhe apni kitab do.'
Seekh: 'give me' = mujhe do, 'your book' = tumhari/apni kitab.
'Wo bahut mehnati ladka hai' English me translate karo.

English: 'He is a very hardworking boy.'
Seekh: 'mehnati' = hardworking, 'bahut' = very. 'Hai' ke liye 'is' aaya kyunki 'He' ekvachan hai.
'We should respect our elders' ka Hindi anuvaad kya hoga?

Hindi: 'Humein apne badon ka samman karna chahiye.'
Seekh: 'should' = chahiye, 'respect' = samman karna, 'elders' = bade-buzurg.
'Meri ghadi kho gayi hai' ko English me kaho.

English: 'I have lost my watch.' ya 'My watch is lost.'
Seekh: 'kho gayi hai' = have lost — kaam abhi pura hua hai, isiliye Present Perfect tense bana.
'Birds fly in the sky' ka Hindi me anuvaad karo.

Hindi: 'Pakshi aasmaan me udte hain.'
Seekh: 'birds' = pakshi (bahuvachan), 'fly' = udte hain, 'sky' = aasmaan.
'Kya tum chai piyoge?' English me kaise puchenge?

English: 'Will you drink tea?' ya vinamrta se 'Would you like to have tea?'
Seekh: 'piyoge' bhavishya me hai isiliye 'will' aaya. Mehman se puchne ke liye dusra vaakya zyada vinamr hai.
'Reading is a good habit' ka Hindi anuvaad do.

Hindi: 'Padhna ek achhi aadat hai.'
Seekh: 'reading' yahan kaam ka naam (noun) bankar aaya hai — 'Padhna'. 'habit' = aadat.
'Wo kal se bimar hai' ko English me translate karo.

English: 'He has been ill since yesterday.'
Seekh: 'kal se' ke liye 'since yesterday' aaya — jab kaam beete samay se ab tak chal raha ho to 'has been' + since lagta hai.
'Practice makes a man perfect' ka Hindi me arth batao.

Hindi arth: 'Abhyas hi manushya ko kushal banata hai.'
Ye ek mashhoor kahawat hai — matlab: jo kaam baar-baar abhyas kiya jaye, usme aadmi mahir ho jata hai. Padhai ho ya khel, roz ka abhyas hi safalta ki kunji hai.
'Sach bolna chahiye' English me kaise kahenge?

English: 'We should speak the truth.' ya 'One should speak the truth.'
Seekh: 'bolna' = speak, 'sach' = truth, 'chahiye' = should.
'India is my country' ka Hindi anuvaad karo.

Hindi: 'Bharat mera desh hai.'
Seekh: 'country' = desh, 'my' = mera. Isi vaakya ko aage badhakar 'All Indians are my brothers and sisters' ko 'Sab Bharatiya mere bhai-behen hain' kehte hain — ye humari pratigya (pledge) ki line hai.
Board exam ki taiyari ke liye best tips do.

Board Exam Taiyari ke Tips:
1. Samay-sarini banao: har vishay ko roz ka samay do, kamzor vishay ko zyada
2. NCERT/kitab pehle: pehle pathya-pustak acche se, phir notes
3. Likhnay ka abhyas: jawab padhne se zyada likhne se yaad hota hai
4. Pichle saalon ke paper: kam se kam 5 saal ke paper samay bandhkar hal karo
5. Revision: har hafte puraani padhai dohrao — 3 baar revision = pakki taiyari
6. Neend aur khana: 7-8 ghante neend, exam se pehle raat bhar mat jagna
7. Chhote notes: aakhri dinon ke liye formula aur mukhya bindu ki copy
Mujhe padhai me man nahi lagta, kya karun?

Padhai me man lagane ke upay:
1. Chhote lakshya rakho: 'aaj 2 page' jaisa chhota target pura karke jeet ka ehsaas lo
2. Mobile door rakho: padhai ke 30 minute phone dusre kamre me
3. Pomodoro tareeka: 25 minute padhai, 5 minute break
4. Sahi jagah: roz ek hi saaf jagah par baitho, man wahi set hota hai
5. Pehle asaan vishay: shuruaat pasandeeda vishay se karo, gati banegi
6. Khud ko inaam do: lakshya pure par chhoti khushi — khel ya pasandeeda khana
Homework jaldi aur sahi karne ka tareeka batao.

Homework ke smart tareeke:
1. Pehle samjho: sawal ko do baar padho, kya pucha hai pehle wo pakdo
2. Mushkil pehle: jab dimag taaza ho tab mushkil homework karo
3. Class notes dekho: jawab aksar din ki padhai me hi chhupa hota hai
4. Ratta nahi, samajh: apne shabdon me likhne se yaad bhi rehta hai
5. Aakhir me jaanch: galtiyon ke liye ek baar upar se padho
6. Roz ka kaam roz: homework jama karna sabse badi galti hai
Pahade (tables) jaldi yaad karne ka trick batao.

Pahade yaad karne ke tricks:
1. Pattern dekho: 9 ke pahade me ankon ka jod hamesha 9 hota hai (18→1+8=9, 27→2+7=9)
2. 5 ka pahada: jawab hamesha 0 ya 5 par khatm hota hai
3. Aadha seekho: 6x7 yaad hai to 7x6 wahi hai — guna ulta karne se jawab wahi
4. Roz 2 pahade: likhkar bolo, bolkar likho — dono se pakka hota hai
5. Khel banao: ghar walo se beech-beech me sawal-jawab karo
Exam me achhe number lane ke liye answer kaise likhte hain?

Achhe jawab likhne ke niyam:
1. Sawal samajhkar likho: jo pucha hai wahi jawab do, extra lambai nahi
2. Bindu (points) me likho: lambe paragraph ki jagah points examiner ko pasand aate hain
3. Mukhya shabd underline karo: jaise paribhasha ke khaas shabd
4. Diagram: vigyan aur bhoogol me saaf naam-wala chitra number dilata hai
5. Safai: saaf handwriting, line kheenchkar hisse alag karo
6. Aakhir me samay bachao: last 10 minute me sab jawab ek baar jaancho
English ke spelling yaad karne ka asaan tareeka kya hai?

Spelling yaad karne ke tareeke:
1. Todkar bolo: 'Wed-nes-day', 'Beau-ti-ful' — tukdo me bolkar likho
2. Dekho-Bolo-Likho: shabd dekho, bolo, phir bina dekhe likho
3. Mashhoor trick: 'i before e, except after c' — believe, receive
4. Kahani banao: 'necessary' ke liye — ek collar (c) aur do sleeves (ss): neCeSSary
5. Roz 5 shabd: copy me 5 baar likho aur vaakya banao — vaakya wala shabd kabhi nahi bhulta
Science ke jawab me diagram kaise banaye?

Ache diagram ke niyam:
1. Pencil se banao, saaf aur bada — aadhe page ka diagram best hota hai
2. Naam (label) ek hi taraf, seedhi line se jodo — line aadi-tirchi na ho
3. Diagram ke neeche uska naam likho: 'Chitra: Manav Hriday'
4. Rang ka istemal aam taur par nahi — pencil hi kaafi hai (jab tak rang bola na jaye)
5. Jawab me diagram ka varnan bhi 2-3 line me do — sirf chitra adhura jawab hota hai
Ratta lagane aur samajhkar padhne me kya farak hai?

- Ratta: bina samjhe dohrana — exam tak yaad, phir gayab. Sawal ghuma kar aaya to atak jaoge.
- Samajhkar padhna: 'kyun' aur 'kaise' janna — ek baar samjha to lambe samay tak yaad, aur ghumaye hue sawal bhi hal ho jate hain.
Best tareeka: pehle samjho, phir apne shabdon me kisi ko samjhao (ya khud ko) — jise samjha sako, wo tumhe aa gaya. Ise 'Feynman technique' bhi kehte hain.
Exam ke din ghabrahat kaise door karun?

Exam ki ghabrahat door karne ke upay:
1. Taiyari hi ilaaj hai: revision pura ho to aadha dar khud khatm
2. Raat ko jaldi so jao: 7-8 ghante ki neend se dimag taaza rehta hai
3. Subah halka nashta: khali pet exam hall mat jao
4. Gehri saans: hall me 4-4-4 ka niyam — 4 second saans lo, 4 roko, 4 me chhodo
5. Asaan sawal pehle: paper milte hi pehle asaan sawal karo, aatm-vishwas banega
6. Dusron se tulna band: apne paper par dhyan do
Notes banane ka sahi tareeka kya hai?

Ache notes banane ka tareeka:
1. Apne shabdon me: kitab ki line copy nahi, samajhkar chhota karke likho
2. Headings aur points: rang-birange pen se mukhya bindu alag dikhao
3. Kinare par jagah: baad me nayi baat jodne ke liye haashiya chhodo
4. Diagram aur table: jahan bane wahan chitra/table banao — tasveer shabdon se tez yaad hoti hai
5. Ek page ka saar: har chapter ke aakhir me 5-6 line ka saaransh likho — revision me yahi kaam aayega
Samajh nahi aata ki revision kab aur kaise karun?

Revision ka sahi tareeka (bhoolne ke curve ko harana):
1. Pehla revision: padhne ke 24 ghante ke andar — 10 minute ka sarasar padhna
2. Dusra revision: 1 hafte baad
3. Teesra revision: 1 mahine baad ya exam se pehle
4. Revision me sirf padho mat — copy band karke yaad karke bolo, phir check karo
5. Mushkil binduon ki alag list banao aur unhi ko zyada dohrao
Ye 1-7-30 wala tareeka padhai ko lambe samay tak yaad rakhta hai.
Class me teacher ki baat acche se kaise note karun?

Class me dhyan dene ke tareeke:
1. Aage ki seat: peeche baithne se dhyan bhatakta hai
2. Mukhya shabd pakdo: teacher jo baat do baar kahe ya board par likhe, wo zaroor note karo
3. Sawal pucho: samajh na aaye to usi samay puchna sabse achha — sharmao mat
4. Ghar aakar usi din: class notes ko usi shaam ek baar padh lo — 5 minute me poora din pakka ho jata hai
5. Dost se tulna: notes milakar dekho, kuch chhut gaya ho to pura karo
Maths ke formula yaad karne ka best tareeka kya hai?

Formula yaad karne ke tareeke:
1. Samajhkar yaad karo: formula bana kaise — jaise aayat ka area lambai x chaudai kyun hai, tasveer se samjho
2. Formula chart: padhai ki deewar par chart lagao, roz nazar padegi
3. Sawal lagao: har formula par kam se kam 5 sawal — istemal se formula dimag me baith jata hai
4. Ek chhoti copy: saare formula ek jagah, bus/train me bhi revision ho jata hai
5. Sone se pehle: 5 minute formula dohrana — neend me dimag use pakka karta hai
Vigyaan (Science) ka mushkil topic kaise samjhun?

Mushkil science topic samajhne ke kadam:
1. Pehle aasan bhasha: topic ko kisi aasan source (video/notes) se kahani ki tarah samjho
2. Roz ki misaal: photosynthesis = paudhe ki rasoi, gravity = seb ka girna — misaal se baat pakki hoti hai
3. Diagram banao: khud haath se chitra banana = aadhi samajh
4. Apne shabdon me likho: 4-5 line me saar likh dalo
5. Sawal khud banao: topic par 3 sawal banakar jawab do — exam ki taiyari bhi ho jayegi
Hindi ke nibandh ko achha kaise likhte hain?

Achha nibandh likhne ke niyam:
1. Sanrachna: Bhoomika (parichay) → Mukhya bhaag (2-3 anuchhed, har me ek bindu) → Upasanhar (nishkarsh)
2. Bhoomika akarshak ho: kahawat, sawal ya chhoti si baat se shuruaat karo
3. Har anuchhed ek hi vichar par: baatein idhar-udhar na bhatkein
4. Udaharan aur kahawat: beech me ek udaharan nibandh ko jaan deta hai
5. Bhasha saral: kathin shabd thopne ki jagah saaf aur sahi bhasha
6. Aakhir me padho: vartani aur viram chinh ki galti sudharo
Duniya ka sabse bada mahadweep kaunsa hai?
Duniya ka sabse bada mahadweep Asia hai. Duniya ki lagbhag 60% aabadi Asia me rehti hai aur Bharat, China, Japan jaise bade desh isi me hain. Sabse chhota mahadweep Australia hai.
Hirakud Bandh kahan hai aur kyun mashhoor hai?

Hirakud Bandh Odisha me Mahanadi nadi par bana hai. Ye duniya ke sabse lambe bandhon me se ek hai (dykes milakar lagbhag 26 km). Ye 1957 me bana tha aur isse sinchai, bijli aur baadh-niyantran me madad milti hai.
Chandrayaan-3 kya tha?

Chandrayaan-3 Bharat ke antriksh sangathan ISRO ka mission tha. 23 August 2023 ko iska lander 'Vikram' Chand ke dakshin dhruv kshetra ke paas safalta se utra — aisa karne wala Bharat duniya ka pehla desh bana. Isme se 'Pragyan' rover nikalkar Chand ki satah par chala tha.
ISRO ka pura naam kya hai?

ISRO ka pura naam Indian Space Research Organisation (Bharatiya Antriksh Anusandhan Sangathan) hai. Iski sthapna 1969 me hui thi aur iska mukhyalaya Bengaluru me hai. Dr. Vikram Sarabhai ko Bharat ke antriksh karyakram ka janak mana jata hai.
Ganga ko Bharat ki rashtriya nadi kyun kehte hain?

Ganga ko 2008 me Bharat ki rashtriya nadi ghoshit kiya gaya tha. Ye Bharat ki sabse lambi aur pavitra mani jane wali nadi hai — karodon log iske kinare rehte hain aur ye kheti, paani aur sanskriti ka aadhar hai.
Ek class me 40 bacche hain. Agar 25% ladkiyan hain to ladkiyon ki sankhya kitni hai?

Step 1: 40 ka 25% nikalo = 40 x 25 / 100
Step 2: 1000 / 100 = 10

Jawab: Class me 10 ladkiyan hain. (Baaki 30 ladke hain — 40 - 10 = 30)
9 aur 12 ka LCM nikalo.

Step 1: 9 ke multiples: 9, 18, 27, 36, 45
Step 2: 12 ke multiples: 12, 24, 36, 48
Step 3: Dono me sabse chhota common multiple = 36

Jawab: LCM = 36
'Was' aur 'Were' kab use karte hain?

Dono 'be' verb ke past roop hain (beeta samay):
- Was: I, He, She, It aur ek naam ke saath — 'I was ill.' 'She was happy.' 'It was hot.'
- Were: You, We, They aur bahuvachan ke saath — 'You were late.' 'They were friends.'
Ek khaas baat: kalpanik baaton me sabke saath 'were' aata hai — 'If I were a bird, I would fly.'
Padhai ke liye ek din ka time-table kaisa hona chahiye?

Ek din ki achhi samay-sarini (school ke baad):
- 4:00–5:00: Aaram aur naashta (dimag taaza)
- 5:00–6:00: Us din ka homework
- 6:00–7:00: Khel-kood (shareer bhi zaroori hai)
- 7:00–8:00: Raat ka khana aur parivar ke saath samay
- 8:00–9:00: Ek vishay ki padhai/revision (roz alag vishay)
- 9:00–9:30: Agle din ka bag taiyaar, halki dohraai
- 9:30–10:00 tak so jana: 8 ghante ki neend zaroori
Note: Samay apne school ke hisaab se badal sakte ho, par padhai-khel-neend ka santulan bana rahe.
'Honesty is the best policy' ka matlab aur chhota paragraph batao.

Is kahawat ka matlab hai: 'Imandari hi sabse achhi neeti hai.'

Paragraph: Imandaar vyakti par sab vishwas karte hain. Jhooth bolkar kuch samay ke liye fayda mil sakta hai, par ek din sach saamne aa hi jata hai aur vishwas toot jata hai. Imandari se man ko shanti milti hai aur samaaj me samman badhta hai. Isiliye kathin samay me bhi sach aur imandari ka raasta hi chunna chahiye.
